Show less Read more Like Dislike Reply @crafty1096 2 weeks ago My Predictions: Best Picture: One Battle After Another, Best Director: Paul Thomas Anderson, Best Actor: Michael B Jordan, “Sinners”, Best Acress: Jessie Buckley, “ Hamnet.” Best Supporting Actor : Delroy Lindo, “Sinners”Best Supporting Actress, Teyana Taylor “One Battle After Another.” Best Original Screenplay Ryan Coogler “Sinners” and Best Adapted screenplay Guillermo Del Toro “Frankenstein” though this category is the one I’m least secure with. I think OBAA is going to take both Director and Picture because it and “Sinners” were the most impressive and PTA is way overdue and unpopular opinion I think the Academy wants to stick it to Trump and wants the historical record to show it. MBJ for actor in “Sinners” because he plays a dual role, “Sinners” will be overlooked for Picture and Director and the Academy overlooked MBJ for “Fruitvale Station.” Jessie Buckley for Actress in “Hamnet” because she’s definitely the best and this is the only category where it seems a total lock due to every other award she’s gotten. Delroy Lindo for Sinners because he’s been a consistent presence and reliable in every movies he’s done over a long period and they may never have a chance to honor him again. Plus they probably will skip Sinners in Director and Picture. Teyana Taylor in OBAA because really her or Amy Madigan should win based on performance but it was a shock that the Academy recognized a Horror Movie role, doubtful she will win too in a horror movie role. Ryan Coogler for best Original screenplay because again they are going to skip Sinners in Picture and Director. Lastly Adapted screenplay I’m not sure . But I don’t see them giving PTA beat adapted screenplay because they are going to give him Director and Picture already. I think Del Toro for Frankenstein or maybe the ladies from Hamnet will get Best Adapted Screenplay because their nomination wasn’t filler and neither was Del Toro or PTA.
